reason_for_change: Recurring upkeep life loss before first main phase increases Abaddon's current-turn cascade threshold when opponents choose life loss; entering as monarch also offers card flow while retained.
commander_identity_impact: Strengthens Abaddon's life-loss threshold engine and cast-from-hand cascade plan.
optimization_tradeoff: Costs one more mana than Loyal Subordinate; opponents may discard instead of losing life; main recurring value begins on a later upkeep.
verification_gate_status: PASS — Oracle, identity, Commander legality, ban-list, rules and structural checks
notes: Black identity fits UBR; no project exception.

reason_for_change: Its life-loss trigger occurs at beginning of combat and requires Abaddon, so it does not help first-main-phase cascade; Court supplies a recurring pre-main trigger and monarch upside.
commander_identity_impact: Moves the threshold role from a commander-dependent combat-step creature to a persistent enchantment.
optimization_tradeoff: Loses a three-mana menace body and an immediate same-turn combat trigger.
verification_gate_status: PASS — cut identity and text checked; final count/singleton verified

reason_for_change: The Lost and the Damned creates a 3/3 Spawn when a spell is cast from outside hand, including cascade hits cast from exile; Warstorm Surge converts each Spawn ETB into 3 damage and also turns other creature ETBs into damage.
commander_identity_impact: Amplifies the cast-from-exile token engine and emphasizes cascade/value/burn over creature-cost reduction.
optimization_tradeoff: Six-mana enchantment with no immediate impact absent creature/token entries; gives up Rakdos's 6/6 flyer/trampler and creature-spell cost discounts.
verification_gate_status: PASS — Oracle, identity, Commander legality, ban-list and strategic interaction checked
notes: Red identity fits UBR; it does not retroactively trigger for creatures that entered before Surge resolved.

reason_for_change: Its reduction applies only to creature spells, while many cascade/exile payoffs and enabling casts are instants, sorceries and enchantments; Warstorm converts the established Spawn engine into repeatable direct damage.
commander_identity_impact: Shifts from conditional creature-cast discounts/combat body to noncombat damage tied to exile-cast tokens.
optimization_tradeoff: Loses a 6/6 flying/trample threat and potentially large discounts when hard-casting creatures; retained fast mana, rituals, Nightscape Familiar, Treasures and Neheb preserve ramp.
verification_gate_status: PASS — revised count, singleton, identity, legality and strategic review
notes: Trade-off is commander-specific; not a claim Rakdos is weak in all Abaddon lists.

reason_for_change: Retains combat-damage draw while adding 6/6 trample body and recast-from-graveyard permission when three tapped Pirates/Vehicles are controlled.
commander_identity_impact: Supports repeatable Pirate combat damage while improving recovery after removal; non-Pirate Vehicle does not increase pirate count.
optimization_tradeoff: Loses Bident’s optional draw and force-attacks activation; The Indomitable draws mandatorily and needs crew 3 to attack.
verification_gate_status: PASS — Oracle, current Commander legality, color identity, rules and structural checks
notes: No project exception; blue identity fits UBR. Graveyard casting still follows normal timing and requires paying costs.

reason_for_change: Functionally overlapping combat-damage draw slot exchanged for a resilient graveyard-recast engine and 6/6 trampler.
commander_identity_impact: Removes Bident’s ability to force opponents’ creatures to attack; its optional draw is lost.
optimization_tradeoff: The deck loses the artifact’s table-politics/forced-attacks ability, and mandatory draw can raise deck-out risk after long multi-combat turns.
verification_gate_status: PASS — cut identity/text checked; final singleton and count verified
notes: Card role overlap was reviewed rather than treating EDHREC presence as a requirement.

reason_for_change: A flying/vigilance Pirate can place flying counters on each creature used to convoke it; persistent, multi-creature evasion better supports three-Pirate combat damage to one opponent.
commander_identity_impact: Increases the chance of making the commander’s three-Pirate trigger connect over multiple turns; remains a Pirate for tribal buffs.
optimization_tradeoff: Costs four mana value versus two; convoking attackers prevents those creatures attacking that turn; it does not grant counters to creatures that did not convoke it.
verification_gate_status: PASS — Oracle, Commander legality, identity, ETB/counters and convoke timing checked
notes: No project exception; blue identity fits UBR. Use spare bodies/tokens to convoke when the current combat needs them.

reason_for_change: Its activated unblockability and combat draw-filter apply to one creature and require repeated {2}{U}; Singer creates durable flying across multiple convokers plus an evasive Pirate body.
commander_identity_impact: Loses a cheap Pirate early play and repeatable one-creature unblockability/filtering.
optimization_tradeoff: The low-curve/loot mode is genuinely valuable; replacement raises printed mana value but supplies broader persistent evasion and convoke flexibility.
verification_gate_status: PASS — revised count, singleton, UBR identity and legality pass
notes: No project exception. Candidate comparison used current Oracle text and current EDHREC cohort only as supporting evidence.

reason_for_change: Its activated ability can remove a finality counter from a Pirate returned by Admiral Brass, Unsinkable; the counter is removed as the cost. Choosing the +1/+1 mode gives an additional counter after resolution, and the creature can return to the graveyard rather than being exiled if it later dies.
commander_identity_impact: Directly mitigates the unique finality-counter drawback and turns the commander's free combat reanimation into a repeatable value engine.
optimization_tradeoff: Two-mana artifact requires untapping and a returned permanent bearing a counter; only one counter can be removed per tap.
verification_gate_status: PASS — current Oracle, color identity, official Commander legality, rules and structural checks
notes: Colorless, Commander legal, no project exception.

reason_for_change: The first-strike Pirate only supplies its value if an opponent has a useful instant or sorcery in their graveyard; its one-shot theft mode is less central to the commander's finality-counter loop.
commander_identity_impact: Trades a conditional opponent-graveyard value Pirate for a permanent that enables repeated use of many returned Pirates.
optimization_tradeoff: Loses a cheap first-strike Pirate and access to a castable opponent instant/sorcery when available.
verification_gate_status: PASS — cut card text/identity/legality, revised count and singleton verified
notes: Card identity red fits UBR; no project exception.

reason_for_change: An untapped utility land that can move a finality counter off a returned Pirate onto another permanent in a main phase; this is a second timing window alongside Power Conduit and is especially useful when Roaming Throne doubles the commander trigger.
commander_identity_impact: Adds a nonspell counter-management line that protects the recursive Pirate engine across multiple returned creatures.
optimization_tradeoff: Gives up an always-tapped UBR source for a colorless land. Remaining fetches, duals, multi-color lands, Cavern/Courtyard and mana rocks preserve dense color fixing.
verification_gate_status: PASS — current Oracle, colorless identity, Commander legality and sorcery-speed timing verified
notes: EDHREC Optimized snapshot: 74/173 decks, 43% inclusion, Lift 52 (snapshot observed 2026-10-13). Supporting evidence only.

reason_for_change: This land always enters tapped and only provides colored mana; it has no commander-specific utility. The deck retains numerous other UBR sources after the swap.
commander_identity_impact: Converts one slow tri-color land into a land that helps protect the commander-reanimated Pirate engine.
optimization_tradeoff: Loses a true three-color source; color availability is assessed against the remaining fetch/dual/tri-color lands and artifact ramp.
verification_gate_status: PASS — final land count remains 34; singleton/identity/count verified
notes: Nesting Grounds enters untapped and adds colorless; no land count change.

reason_for_change: A lower-cost Pirate with flying/ward whose ETB can temporarily blank up to one artifact or creature per player, giving the repeatable commander-reanimation line a multi-permanent interaction option.
commander_identity_impact: Adds a flexible Pirate ETB target that gains value from the commander returning Pirates with haste; Power Conduit can clear the finality counter to allow future reuse if it dies.
optimization_tradeoff: The transformation is temporary and targets become Treasure artifacts that opponents may sacrifice for mana; the effect ends if Larcenist leaves.
verification_gate_status: PASS — current Oracle, identity, Commander legality and ETB targets/rulings checked
notes: Blue identity fits UBR; current reference states Commander legal. The effect is not permanent removal.

reason_for_change: Amphin provides strong single-creature exile but costs four mana and gives the target’s controller a 4/3 Salamander. Larcenist costs three, has flying/ward, and can address multiple artifacts/creatures across the table.
commander_identity_impact: Retains a Pirate ETB-interaction slot while improving mana efficiency and multiplayer reach.
optimization_tradeoff: Loses Amphin’s true exile-until-leaves effect and Encore. Larcenist’s Treasure conversion is temporary, not hard removal.
verification_gate_status: PASS — revised card count, UBR identity and singleton verified
notes: Card identity blue fits UBR; no project exception.

reason_for_change: Magecraft triggers on the cast and on Anhelo’s casualty copy; each creates a Fractal with +1/+1 counters equal to the instant/sorcery mana value, giving scalable bodies that become future casualty-2 fodder.
commander_identity_impact: Blue color identity fits UBR; token color words do not add green to the card identity.
optimization_tradeoff: Costs five instead of four; Fractals do not fly. Deekah’s unblockability activation costs {3}{U} and only affects a creature token for the turn.
verification_gate_status: PASS — Oracle, identity, Commander legality, rules and structural checks
notes: Current EDHREC Optimized snapshot: Deekah 39/173 (23%, Lift 45); supporting signal only.

reason_for_change: Talrand triggers when an instant/sorcery is cast, but not on the copy produced by Anhelo; it makes a fixed 2/2 flying Drake rather than mana-value-scaled tokens from both original and copy.
commander_identity_impact: Moves the spell-copy payoff slot toward Anhelo’s defining copied-spell mechanic.
optimization_tradeoff: Loses a four-mana 2/2 and potentially repeated flying Drakes on future casts; Deekah costs five and its bodies do not fly unless separately enabled by its activation.
verification_gate_status: PASS — cut Oracle/identity/legal status, final count and singleton checked
notes: Current EDHREC Optimized snapshot: Talrand 98/173 (57%, Lift 29); popularity is not the decision rationale.

reason_for_change: The four-mana sorcery is an excellent casualty-2 target: each opponent splits their creatures into piles and the controller chooses which pile they sacrifice. Anhelo’s copy resolves first, then the original asks opponents to pile their remaining creatures again.
commander_identity_impact: Black identity fits UBR; makes a non-targeted, multiplayer-scale removal spell central to copied-spell strategy.
optimization_tradeoff: Four mana and board-dependent; each opponent may mitigate the effect with pile decisions. Copy creates an additional resolution, while the sacrifice cost is paid only for the original cast.
verification_gate_status: PASS — Oracle, identity, Commander legality, stack sequencing and structure checked
notes: Current EDHREC Optimized snapshot: Make an Example 44/173 (25%, Lift 50).

reason_for_change: Talrand’s Invocation creates two 2/2 flying Drakes and becomes four Drakes when copied, but it is another four-mana token burst in a deck that retains multiple other copied token sources; Make an Example exchanges that burst for copied multi-opponent creature control.
commander_identity_impact: Reduces redundant token burst while retaining token finishers Army of the Damned, copied casualty/fodder from Baral and Kari Zev, Judith, Lagomos, Poppet Stitcher and Deekah.
optimization_tradeoff: This is a meaningful loss: the cut spell can yield four flying Drakes for one casualty payment. The chosen replacement is more interactive but depends on opponents having creatures.
verification_gate_status: PASS — cut text/identity/legal status and revised list checked
notes: Current EDHREC Optimized snapshot: Talrand’s Invocation 11/173 (6.4%, Lift 108); Lift is not treated as a mandatory-add signal.
